(rule!
  (let ((dummy 0))
    (define (rect-border? obj)
      (let* ((bb (obj-bbox obj))
             (h (+ (- (third bb) (first bb)) 1))
             (w (+ (- (fourth bb) (second bb)) 1))
             (border-size (- (* h w) (* (max 0 (- h 2)) (max 0 (- w 2))))))
        (and (>= (obj-size obj) 8)
             (= (obj-size obj) border-size)
             (all? (lambda (p)
                     (or (= (first p) (first bb)) (= (first p) (third bb))
                         (= (second p) (second bb)) (= (second p) (fourth bb))))
                   (obj-cells obj)))))
    (let* ((frame (first (filter rect-border? (objects g 0))))
           (bb (obj-bbox frame))
           (interior (filter (lambda (cell)
                               (let ((v (third cell)))
                                 (and (not (= v 0))
                                      (> (first cell) (first bb))
                                      (< (first cell) (third bb))
                                      (> (second cell) (second bb))
                                      (< (second cell) (fourth bb)))))
                             (grid-cells g)))
           (a (third (first interior)))
           (b (third (second interior)))
           (with-border (paint-cells (empty-grid (rows g) (cols g) 0) (obj-cells frame) (obj-color frame))))
      (for*/fold ([out with-border])
                 ([r (in-range (+ (first bb) 1) (third bb))]
                  [c (in-range (+ (second bb) 1) (fourth bb))])
        (set-cell out r c
                  (if (= (modulo (+ (- r (+ (first bb) 1)) (- c (+ (second bb) 1))) 2) 0) a b))))))
